hoy.titular: Referee named: Venezuela's Jesús Valenzuela will take charge of the final against Palmeiras

foto.alt: Coaching staff give instructions to two players during a training session at City Bell.

hoy.resumen: CONMEBOL appointed Venezuelan Jesús Valenzuela for Saturday 28th's final at the Centenario: he refereed the Pincha's 1-0 win over Corinthians in the quarter-finals. It also opened an extra sale of around a thousand seats, exclusive to Banco Provincia Mastercard holders, while the squad continue their build-up at City Bell.

siete.texto: CONMEBOL released around 1,000 more seats for the final via ElevenTickets, only for Banco Provincia Mastercard holders. The sale runs until Wednesday 18th at 19:00 or until sold out; the club made clear it is not organising it.

CONMEBOL chose Venezuelan Jesús Valenzuela, with an all-Venezuelan crew and Juan Soto on VAR. He refereed the Pincha's 1-0 win over Corinthians in the quarter-finals; Palmeiras are unbeaten with him this year.

siete.titulo: Correa a doubt for the final
siete.texto: He is nursing a grade 2 tear in the biceps of his right leg and kept working apart from the group as training resumed. Even if he is cleared, he will lack match rhythm: a starting place is far from certain.

The squad keep training at City Bell until the trip to Montevideo, with Sunday 22nd off. Correa is doing physio apart, while Carrillo and Castro are being managed for muscle fatigue: the coaching staff are dosing the load without losing intensity.

siete.titulo: González Pirez: "I think about the match all the time"
siete.texto: The defender spoke to DSports about his nerves ahead of the final, played down the refereeing debate and praised Carrillo, Rojo and Verón.

They visit Cruzeiro on Wednesday 18th at 20:30 at the Mineirão in the Brasileirão, without Piquerez (right thigh injury), Murilo or Paulinho. Then come Flamengo (21st) and Chapecoense (24th), four days before the final.

siete.titulo: Recopa could be played in La Plata
siete.texto: Winning the Supercopa puts the Pincha into January's Recopa de Campeones round-robin with Rosario Central and the Copa Argentina winners. The Estadio Único Diego Armando Maradona (not the UNO, the Pincha's own ground) is one possible venue, but AFA has yet to confirm it.

linea.texto: Jesús Valenzuela will referee the final between Estudiantes and Palmeiras at the Centenario.
Palmeiras wrapped up preparations for their trip to Cruzeiro with five absentees, Piquerez among them.
CONMEBOL opened an extra seat sale for the final, only for Banco Provincia Mastercard holders.
The Pincha could play January's Recopa de Campeones in La Plata; the venue is not yet confirmed.
González Pirez on the final: "I think about the match all the time".
Estudiantes trained again at City Bell after the title in Córdoba, with Palmeiras already in mind.
Operation Montevideo: the squad are back in training with the focus on the final.
With the Supercopa trophy and plenty of joy, this is how preparations for the Libertadores final began.
Palmeiras still have no return date for Piquerez: he hurt his thigh with Uruguay and is a doubt for the final.
In Brazil there are warnings about Palmeiras' workload: 270 minutes in seven days before the final.
Two key weeks begin: the countdown starts on Monday and Medina gets key players back for the final.
The basketball team closed the Pre Federal regular season with a 71-56 win over Riberas del Paraná; Racing de Olavarría await in the play-offs.
Correa steps up his recovery at City Bell to arrive in the best possible shape for the final on the 28th.
